title: Fantastisk
body:

author: wiggo F

title: Pretty good
body: Overall a good task manager, but am missing a few things to bring it up to par with Todoist. 1) better calendar integration. I should be able to drag and drop all-day tasks to different time slots in google calendar. I should also be able to define different durations and not live with the default 30 mins. 2) I should be able to search my tasks. Kind of funny google doesn’t support that.

title: This could be great..
